observation.visible_scene: A close-up view of a burning sparkler set against a uniformly dark background. A bright yellow-white combustion point occupies the center of the frame, with a short orange-red stick visible just below it. From this tip, numerous thin golden spark trails radiate outward in a starburst pattern, several ending in small star-like flares.
visible_changes: The sparkler is already burning at the first frame and continues burning steadily through the last frame; the bright central tip and the orange-red stick below it persist throughout without extinguishing.

The configuration of radiating spark trails changes from frame to frame: thin streaks continuously shoot outward from the tip, extend, and fade, so the overall starburst flickers and reshapes while remaining centered on the tip.

A few isolated sparks appear detached from the main burst near the frame edges (e.g., corners or sides), positioned farther from the tip than the dense inner spray, consistent with individual sparks traveling outward.
The bright tip and stick drift only slightly in position within the frame across the excerpt, staying approximately centered the whole time.
outside_clip_unknowns: When the sparkler was lit and when it will burn out (both ends of the clip are arbitrary crop boundaries, not the start or end of combustion).
What holds or supports the sparkler.
The outcome of the burning beyond the last frame.
uncertain_details: Whether the small positional shift of the sparkler within the frame is due to camera movement or movement of the sparkler itself, since the pure black background provides no reference.
The exact material or identity of the orange-red stick below the tip.
Whether stray sparks near the edges are newly emitted or older sparks that have simply traveled farther out.
